## Summary

Describe the change and the behavior it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
- [ ] I ran `python benchmark/evaluate.py --help`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when executable behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated documentation when the public contract changed.
- [ ] I did not include private chain-of-thought, secrets, credentials, or fabricated benchmark telemetry.

## Benchmark-impacting changes

If this changes `SKILL.md`, scoring, collapse/revival behavior, benchmark schemas, or evaluation logic, explain how existing results should be interpreted and whether new community runs are needed.
